operations.description: The single endpoint for all monday.com API operations. Send GraphQL queries and mutations as JSON in the request body.

Idempotency-Key.description: Client-generated key (UUID recommended) that makes mutations idempotent. On the first request the response is cached for 30 minutes; retries with the same key return the cached response without re-executing the mutation. Ignored on queries. A concurrent request with the same key returns 409 until the first completes.
